scripts.openapi:check: pnpm generate && pnpm shared:build && pnpm --filter @tmmin-henkaten/api run openapi:check
scripts.shared:build: pnpm --filter @tmmin-henkaten/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @tmmin-henkaten/test-fixtures run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm generate && pnpm shared:build && pnpm -r --sort --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: pnpm generate && pnpm shared:build && pnpm -r --sort --if-present run test:unit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm generate && pnpm shared:build && pnpm --filter @tmmin-henkaten/api run test:integration
scripts.test:baseline: pnpm generate && pnpm shared:build && pnpm --filter @tmmin-henkaten/api run test:baseline
scripts.validate: pnpm runtime:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm openapi:check && pnpm build
